phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: Owners tabled a revised hard cap starting in 2028, the union rejected it, and a lockout after Dec. 1 is still widely expected.
latest: Union head Bruce Meyer said MLB has refused to discuss economics beyond a salary cap, calling the months of talks wasted, while owners continue three days of meetings in New York. Commissioner Rob Manfred is due to assess the talks Wednesday.
next_milestone: Owners meetings end; Manfred assesses talks
